confidence_notes: Meal and coffee anchors triangulate several Chengdu price snippets, mostly undated or from small samples. Beer relies on pub and club samples rather than restaurant menus. Cocktail relies on a few venue samples. Wine by the glass has no Chengdu-specific data and is set relative to the beer anchor (roughly three to four times it), so it is the weakest drink anchor. Hostel and hotel anchors are general-knowledge estimates for July 2026; no accommodation search or live listing check was done. CNY prices were converted at an approximate 6.9 CNY per USD, not a checked rate. FX is not the latest observation: the single RBA search returned a table which, as reported in the search results, covers 18 to 20 March 2026 (last entry 0.7088 USD per AUD on 20 March). No later RBA observation was confirmed, and a non-RBA aggregator value was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city anchors the set. Meal and coffee figures come from Chengdu-specific search snippets. Beer and cocktail samples are from Chengdu venues. Wine is set relative to beer. Non-Chengdu price points seen in search results (for example Shanghai, Tianjin and Guangzhou) were treated as directional only. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of similar second-tier Chinese provincial capitals with comparable tourist demand.
